answer: File-hash enrollment still lets one garage mint many voters. Each applicant gets one coastal beacon and an 18-minute metered burn, filmed by two separately housed cameras as a plume of temperature-color samples. A laser-etched pearl of posted mass enters a public brine well claimable by only one key. Clerks post commit=keccak256(addr||series||beacon_id||pearl_serial||mass_mg). Burn costs 0.42 POA; 15 POA locks for eight epochs. Peers replay the flare tape and recompute the commit. A reused serial, shared orifice, or near-duplicate curve forfeits the lock and mutes both keys for eleven epochs.
